Indian Men's Hockey Team slams seven goals to decimate Pakistan in FIH Pro League
India produced a sensational attacking performance to defeat arch-rivals Pakistan 7-1 in the reverse fixture of their FIH Pro League London leg on June 26. Despite trailing early in the first quarter, India responded with seven brilliant goals from Sukhjeet Singh (20’), Harmanpreet Singh (26’), Hardik Singh (34’), Jugraj Singh (35’), Abhishek (41’), Raj Kumar Pal (44’) and Dilpreet Singh (54’) to secure all three points.
